snippets.title: Sign requests with a TAP attestation (agent)
snippets.note: From the MPP identity docs (MIT). Intent payment maps to the tag agent-payer-auth and browse to agent-browser-auth; the signer uses an 8-minute lifetime by default. Visa publishes no TAP SDK of its own; the visa/trusted-agent-protocol sample is under Visa's Product Terms and is not reproduced here.

snippets.title: Verify TAP attestations on a server
snippets.note: From the MPP identity docs. The verifier checks signature, authority and path, lifetime, tag and nonce. Resolve keyId only from agent providers you trust; Store.memory() fits a single process only.
